findings.detail: Short-term investment BlackRock Liquidity T-Fund fair value 71,644 thousand is part of Total Investments at fair value but is absent from the extracted position sum.
Unfunded commitments fair value of negative 4,234 thousand is outside Total Investments at fair value but appears to have been included in the extracted position sum.

rationale: The filing total and companyfacts anchor agree at 4,246,035 thousand. The schedule shows non-controlled/non-affiliated investments of 4,174,391 thousand plus short-term investments of 71,644 thousand, tying to Total Investments at fair value of 4,246,035 thousand. The observed extracted sum of 4,170,156 thousand is approximately the non-controlled investment subtotal after subtracting the separate negative unfunded commitments total of 4,234 thousand, so the conservation failure is a real extraction/classification error rather than a bad anchor.
